candidates.prompt:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse.
Placement: article hero, also guide card. Output crop: wide landscape 16:9, high resolution 2048 by 1152 or larger.
Subject: Part 3 — Embeddings, Chunking and Vector Search: Keep the Exception With the Rule.
Verified context: The fixed-window vector result begins with the person who may authorize deployment, but leaves the condition in the preceding chunk. In this case, changing the boundary repairs the evidence unit before any answer model is involved.
Visual idea: Two pale stone fragments hold opposite halves of a continuous terracotta seam; one overlapping translucent mineral sheet keeps the join visible. This is one concrete editorial metaphor for a conditional relationship preserved across divided evidence. It is not a literal technical mechanism, graph or measured outcome.
Canonical composition: a low oblique still life of two rough ivory stone slabs separated by a narrow vertical cut. One terracotta mineral vein continues from one slab into the other at the cut. A single thin translucent mica sheet overlaps the join at an angle so both halves of the vein remain visible. Compact centered silhouette, quiet cream background.
Use the inspected docs/reference-layouts/story.html role and the actual guide page: wide artwork after the introduction, centered object-fit cover at 21:9 desktop and 16:9 mobile, 3:2 cards and square narrow rows. Cluster the split, terracotta seam and overlapping sheet safely in the central half; leave generous warm negative space.
Art direction: a restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Use deliberate geometry, fine lines, subtle paper texture, and a single clear focal idea legible at thumbnail size. Harmonize warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, and sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious, strong contrast, tactile matte stone and subtle mineral translucency, controlled spatial depth and quiet directional shadows. Match the production references' restrained archive/material editorial family, while omitting all markings. Avoid glossy product advertising.
Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. Give the central fragments and overlap real physical/spatial presence, material detail, subtle depth and hierarchy. Any fine line supports the substantial forms.
Depict only supported context. No actual technical plot or implication of guaranteed retrieval or correct AI answers.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots or generic glowing AI brains. No pseudo-writing, ruler marks, ticks, diagrams, arrows, headlines or screenshot imitation. No magnifying glasses, gears, hands, people, computers or puzzle-piece icons. No border or frame.
Deliver one clean coherent high-resolution artwork, not panels or a comparison sheet.
